symptom: iPhone Safari Cesium render aborts with RangeError: Invalid array length after blend-stabilization patch.
objective: Restore the last owner-proven Google Photorealistic render path first. Preserve ion URL stripping and AR/blend gating where they do not affect Cesium tile allocation. Do not pursue visual quality until crash-free mobile render is restored.
patches: Remove tileset.immediatelyLoadDesiredLevelOfDetail=true. Explicitly set it false or leave default.

Restore the last owner-proven mobile tileset policy: skipLevelOfDetail=true; maximumScreenSpaceError=16 on mobile / 8 desktop; cacheBytes=256 MiB mobile / 768 MiB desktop; dynamicScreenSpaceError=true with Cesium defaults.
Remove per-frame tuneTilesForAlt SSE reduction for this hotfix. Do not drive mobile SSE down to 2 while descending.
Remove stabilization-only dynamicScreenSpaceErrorFactor/Density/HeightFalloff overrides; use Cesium defaults until crash-free proof.

For clipping, call Cesium.ClippingPolygonCollection.isSupported(viewer.scene) before creating/assigning clipping polygons. If unsupported, set parcelClippingActive=false and continue rendering without clipping; never crash the scene.
Restore the simple canonical parcel ring used in the last owner-proven build for the crash hotfix. Do not add/reverse/duplicate the closing vertex in this pass.
Keep GLB delayed reveal and A-F AR labels hidden until blendComplete, but if parcel clipping is unsupported allow LOCAL_FALLBACK_BLEND so the flight continues instead of aborting.

Set viewer.scene.rethrowRenderErrors=false and add a renderError listener that records window.__AUMARA.renderError without displaying Cesium's fatal error panel in guest mode; debug mode may expose details. Do not swallow the failure silently in telemetry.

acceptance.owner_iPhone_Safari: Google Photorealistic first tile renders and scene continues for at least 20 seconds without RangeError/RenderLoopError

evidence: owner mobile screenshot after 20s crash-free render
stop_rule: CRASH FIRST. Do not optimize tile quality, do not change GLB, do not redesign blend, do not create a new project. Restore proven render -> owner proof -> only then resume visual stabilization incrementally.
